timing: Frozen after reading saved candidate metadata and exploratory solved-text key-fit probes, before running the nine LP2 candidate key fits or outputs.
repair: The original main loop calls a broken pattern_solver and then unconditionally continues; its break_cipher branch is unreachable. Execute break_cipher's saved-row body directly without claiming the original script produced a negative result.
saved_row_filter: Exact probability.py db_norm filter: score>=0.55 and interrupt rune index 0 (F); nine rows in three LP2 sections, order preserved. No new candidate generation.
source_clock: Use db_indices first 20 F rune positions; if at least 21 occur, fit only before the 21st F. Remove each listed 1-based F occurrence from that fit prefix. Solver preserves skipped F and advances the periodic key only on non-skipped runes; punctuation does not advance it. Decode the full source section with the fitted key.

controls.authentic: Source p57_parable runes, unencrypted with key length 1 and no skips; both key-fit branches must return identity and exact full 95-rune reading.
controls.matched_length: First 419, 416, and 472 GP runes of source _solved.txt, encrypted separately with periodic key lengths 14, 26, and 20. Those are the three source fit-prefix lengths before skipping. Vigenere key b_j=(7j+3) mod29. Affine key a_j=((5j+1) mod28)+1, b_j=(7j+3) mod29. The full fitted key and complete plaintext must recover exactly; report each branch/length, do not tune after outcomes. No F skipping in this language control, so it is easier than target fitting.
controls.skip_fixture: A separate short constructed string with selected F interruptions must match source solver's clock and preserve skipped F. This checks mechanics, not language power.
controls.interpretation: A branch may be called a bounded negative only if all three matched-length controls for that branch recover completely and the exact source threshold is calibrated; otherwise target outputs are descriptive candidate replay only. Authentic length-1 success alone is not sufficient.

target_output: For each of the nine saved rows and both source solvers, preserve fitted key, mean source similarity, source-threshold decision, full source-section decoded GP indices hash, and readable prefix. No post hoc word scoring or arbitrary key changes.
limits: Saved candidate rows and source model are historical inputs; target LP2 outcomes were not inspected before this plan. The matched-length controls are conditional on the source's English unigram model and do not cover other languages, key schedules, interruptions or corpora.
